___tiiiir___: In Kesselby, Albin Tiiiir was a baker. In N-F5, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a baker again.

Albin Tiiiir had just lit a cigarette at N-F5 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell of the Concord (@wpjarrell07).
Albin Tiiiir rejoined the squad at N-F5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
alex_stjohn_: Walter Stjohn joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Walter Stjohn watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Walter Stjohn fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Karel "Saint" Zebra was grazed.
A parcel from home held a comb. Walter Stjohn has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Walter Stjohn fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Wendel Shitter was badly wounded. Walter Stjohn ate breakfast without a word.

Walter Stjohn fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Wendel Photography, grazed. Walter Stjohn felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Walter Chandlerz of the Concord (@the_skyler_of_chandlerz).
The medics cleaned Walter Stjohn's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at P-F3.
A bullet grazed Walter Stjohn's ribs at P-F3. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Walter Chandlerz of the Concord (@the_skyler_of_chandlerz).
ami_ne_dz13: The old hands of R-C1 have been here since Day 1. Henrik Ami has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A round went through Henrik Ami's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Isidor Hohlmike of the Hegemony (@hohlmike4). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C1. Henrik Ami has learned to walk bent double.

Henrik Ami walked back up the communication trench to R-C1, slower than before, but on his own feet. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik Ami is number 788. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik Ami kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Henrik Ami fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Nils "Mud" Tacomeister was badly wounded. Henrik Ami ate breakfast without a word.
Henrik Ami checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Henrik Ami gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Henrik Ami cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.

Henrik Ami reached up to fix a sandbag at R-C1 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Yummygraingo of the Hegemony (@yummygraingoestomytummy).
Henrik Ami came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
bartdrent: "You're late," said the corporal when Wendel Bartdrent arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A parcel came for Wendel Bartdrent that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-S3 and grazed Wendel Bartdrent's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bram Toaster of the Hegemony (@glorified_toaster). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Wendel Bartdrent watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home reached Wendel Bartdrent before dusk. Wendel Bartdrent read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel Bartdrent's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-S3 the same hour. Wendel Bartdrent got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 543. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Bartdrent stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel's address was smudged. Wendel Bartdrent took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Wendel Bartdrent splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Wendel Bartdrent was hit in the hip at R-S3. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic.
Wendel Bartdrent lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Wendel Bartdrent recovered anyway and is back at R-S3.

Wendel Bartdrent was hit in the forearm at R-S3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Florian Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy).
cko1945: Ivo Cko arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a rosary of rough beads and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-R7 changed before the cheering ended. Ivo Cko shouldered another load.

Ivo Cko and Florian Jthompson made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ivo Cko shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Ivo Cko worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
A bullet went through Ivo Cko's sleeve at S-R7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Walter Nightrunner of the Concord (@nightrunner289).
Ivo Cko walked back up the communication trench to S-R7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
A bullet grazed Ivo Cko's ribs at S-R7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo Gabhita of the Concord (@gabhita09).

Machine-gun fire swept S-R7. Ivo Cko took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ivo Gabhita of the Concord (@gabhita09). There was no room for Ivo Cko. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Walter Cko put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Ivo Cko helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Walter Cko's ear at S-R7 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Ivo Hansaazz of the Concord (@hansaazz).
cthulhu1703: Day 10. The corporal put Walter "Spark" Cthulhu beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Walter "Spark" Cthulhu borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Ulrich Stalierino was grazed. Walter "Spark" Cthulhu reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Otto "Shadow" Ghost of the Hegemony (@tf141simon_riley_ghost). The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F9, Walter "Spark" Cthulhu listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Three days with a bandage, and Walter "Spark" Cthulhu is back at P-F9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Walter "Spark" Cthulhu saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Walter "Spark" Cthulhu lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Walter "Spark" Cthulhu fired, and Lucien "Parson" Tec was grazed.

Walter "Spark" Cthulhu rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Gustav Bobopomaranc was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Walter "Spark" Cthulhu fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Leopold Gardinerryke, grazed.

Walter "Spark" Cthulhu felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F9. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir "Shadow" Bobopomaranc of the Hegemony (@bobopomarancza).
dragos.jrca: Isidor Jrca arrived at S-S1 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Isidor Jrca was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Nils Noah of the Concord (@noah813768). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Isidor Jrca helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Back on the fire step at S-S1. Isidor Jrca says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Isidor Jrca is number 644. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Isidor Jrca let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Isidor Jrca began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
The reply to Isidor Jrca's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Isidor Jrca traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
A pump handle snapped off in Isidor Jrca's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Isidor Jrca asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
Isidor Jrca drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below the Brickworks the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
embersky446: By the time Konrad Embersky reached R-R2, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Machine-gun fire swept R-R2. Konrad Embersky took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Bastian Mrbojo of the Concord (@mrbojo1992). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Konrad Embersky did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

There was never a bed for Konrad Embersky, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-R2 on his own feet. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Konrad Embersky wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R2 and grazed Konrad Embersky's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Karel "Ash" Johannmigano of the Concord (@johannmigano).
Back on the fire step at R-R2. Konrad Embersky says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Konrad Embersky dreamt he was back in Old Harrow, working as a baker. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Konrad Embersky raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R2. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix of the Concord (@dratlaix).
Konrad Embersky's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Konrad Embersky wrote a letter for Ulrich Nickloser's mother, because Ulrich could not find the words. Ulrich signed it.
garbet7532: Gideon Garbet arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a rosary of rough beads and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Casimir Joncheng and Gideon Garbet carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Gideon Garbet read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Gideon Garbet owes Karel Servantofgod so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Gideon Garbet became a stretcher bearer today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Gideon Garbet saved the last of the sugar for Leopold "Tin" Guy's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Tin's birthday. It was a good day anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gideon Garbet dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Gideon Garbet across the shin at U-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bram Eliyork of the Hegemony (@eliyork13). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Garbet. Gideon Garbet read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Back on the fire step at U-F9. Gideon Garbet says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter reached Gideon Garbet in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

A parcel from home held a comb. Gideon Garbet has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Gideon Garbet kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
gaunt_ghost_611: The draft reached Q-F23 on Day 10. Viktor Ghost was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Fresh from training, Viktor Ghost still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston, grazed. The sergeant at Q-F23 called out a range and a spot. Viktor Ghost was the only one who hit it. Rafael "Saint" Arthur was gravely wounded. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Viktor Ghost helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Viktor Ghost fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Leopold Wihanholtzha was grazed.
Viktor Ghost wrote a song about the Drowned Farm. Nils "Mud" Tacomeister wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Viktor Ghost made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Officers came to inspect Q-F23. Viktor Ghost polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Zeno Edge stood up to sing louder, and Viktor Ghost fired. Zeno Edge was grazed. The singing stopped.

Viktor Ghost hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. Viktor Ghost got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
gregoriousdonder: Nils Gregoriousdo unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-C2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Nils Gregoriousdo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier.

At S-C2 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Nils Gregoriousdo won the bet. Rafael Ware was grazed. Nils Gregoriousdo fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Emil Awan was badly wounded. Nils Gregoriousdo ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier. Nils Gregoriousdo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 863. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Nils Gregoriousdo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Nils Gregoriousdo taught Gustav Foad three words in the language of home. Gustav uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier. Nils Gregoriousdo asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Nils Gregoriousdo fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Hugo "Saint" Guacamole was grazed. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-C2. Nils Gregoriousdo saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Cyril Creason was grazed. A letter from home reached Nils Gregoriousdo before dusk. Nils Gregoriousdo read it twice and slept a little easier.
Nils Gregoriousdo let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Clement Majormalprac was grazed.

Nils Gregoriousdo had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Jakub Jacobsoifu was grazed. A letter for Nils Gregoriousdo came with a pressed flower inside. Nils Gregoriousdo showed the flower to nobody.

Nils Gregoriousdo and Benedikt "Mole" Neumann have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out. Nils Gregoriousdo read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
guacamole_1354: The new rifleman is Henrik Guacamole, once a bookbinder from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a bookbinder was any use in a trench. Henrik Guacamole said he would find out.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Henrik Guacamole fired, and Casimir Olo was badly wounded. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-R4, Henrik Guacamole listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Henrik Guacamole's ear at S-R4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik Dmt of the Hegemony (@rares.dmt_). Henrik Guacamole got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 951. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik Guacamole kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Machine-gun fire swept S-R4. Henrik Guacamole took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt of the Hegemony (@hackermt90). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Henrik Guacamole fell at S-R4 and never moved again. Shot by Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt of the Hegemony (@hackermt90).
Hugo "Saint" Guacamole came to the front because his brother Henrik Guacamole never came home. He carries a pressed cornflower.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Hugo "Saint" Guacamole across the shin at S-R4. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder).

A single shot from across the wire hit Hugo "Saint" Guacamole in the thigh at S-R4. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Silas "Bones" Hunterplum of the Hegemony (@hunterplum). The bearers reached Hugo "Saint" Guacamole at S-R4 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Silas "Bones" Hunterplum of the Hegemony (@hunterplum).
The House of Guacamole sent Arno Guacamole after Hugo "Saint" Guacamole. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Arno Guacamole felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R4. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ivo Enriquez of the Hegemony (@marco.n.enriquez).
Arno Guacamole rejoined the squad at S-R4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Arno Guacamole was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R4. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29). The bearers set Arno Guacamole's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man.
just_hansell19: Isidor Hansell reached V-F14 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Isidor Hansell said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Isidor Hansell tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Tobias "Tin" Kaijkrause taught Isidor Hansell three words in the language of home. Isidor uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.

Isidor Hansell jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Silas Menac. The Concord medics will be busy. (@dennisth3_menac) Isidor Hansell went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Isidor Hansell on the wire, halfway home.
Otto Hansell had heard about Isidor Hansell's courage. At V-F14, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Otto Hansell found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
kat_catto: Yann Catto, a railway porter from Old Harrow, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in V-F17. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Yann Catto taught Zeno "Bones" Evanburke to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Officers came to inspect V-F17. Yann Catto polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Zeno "Bones" Evanburke carried Yann Catto's rifle all the way up to Grey Mill after Yann twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Yann Catto went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Yann Catto only heard boots on the duckboards at V-F17, then nothing but pain. Raider: Gustav Oskr of the Hegemony (@lopz.oskr). Nobody could reach Yann Catto in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Dorian Catto arrived carrying the family name of Yann Catto. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Dorian Catto won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in V-F17. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
kusziko: On Day 10, Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Someone asked Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko won before reaching the end of his entry.
Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'

The men at T-F8 heard Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Tobias "Hollow" Evie of the Concord (@evie.sh207). A single shot at T-F8. Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Tobias "Hollow" Evie of the Concord (@evie.sh207).
Dorian Kusziko came to the front because his uncle Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko never came home. He carries a frozen apple.
mcdonnell_cody: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Roland Cody. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F8. Roland Cody has learned to walk bent double.

The cook borrowed Roland Cody's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. Roland Cody transferred to the riflemans. The men in V-F8 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Roland Cody kept Felix Type awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Roland could have walked there blind. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Cody. Roland Cody read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Roland Cody tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at V-F8 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Cody. Roland Cody read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Rain blew in under the dugout door. Roland Cody moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Cody. Roland Cody read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Cody saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at V-F8 and fired once. Gideon Misahmisery was badly wounded. A letter came for Roland Cody with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Roland Cody pinned it to the dugout wall.
The parcel for Roland Cody contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
mischief077: By the time Florian Mischief reached M-F9, the war was 16 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Florian Mischief lent Lucien Coreyjmcmich a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Florian Mischief. Florian Mischief guessed what they were and laughed.
noah_the_0ne: The new rifleman gave his name as Albin The. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Albin The was hit twice at S-C4, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec). Albin The looked over the parapet at S-C4 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec).
Quentin The put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Albin The helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A man asked Quentin The to describe Esterhaus without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Quentin The got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 743. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-C4 with the rations. Quentin The ate while listening to the revised orders.
Quentin The owes Quentin Alfeo so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Quentin The had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Anselm Boxknight was grazed.
At S-C4 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Quentin The won the bet. Rafael "Parson" Olo was grazed.
Quentin The held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.
Quentin The rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Bastian Tzukitolotl was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Quentin The won before reaching the end of his entry.
pathfinder074: Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. The new duty roster listed Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S10. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder of the Concord and Hugo Karl of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder and Henrik Jdavidfranci carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. A letter from home reached Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder before dusk. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder read it twice and slept a little easier.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
The list for Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder and Emil Hartilllondo share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
A bullet hit Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder's belt buckle at Q-S10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dietrich Juliofck of the Hegemony (@juliofck).
varsikasikranaatti: Felix Varsikasikra reported to S-F12 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Felix Varsikasikra is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F12, Felix Varsikasikra listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Felix Varsikasikra saw Severin Heheheha freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Felix said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Felix Varsikasikra checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

The barrage caught Felix Varsikasikra in the open at S-F12. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Felix Varsikasikra was carried in at last. Felix Varsikasikra is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F12 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Varsikasikra shouldered another load.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Felix Varsikasikra did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.
There was never a bed for Felix Varsikasikra, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F12 on his own feet.

Felix Varsikasikra traded a lock of hair in a matchbox for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Felix Varsikasikra fired. Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was badly wounded. Felix Varsikasikra let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Valentin Zle was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Felix Varsikasikra only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Isidor Glc of the Concord (@leo.glc). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Felix Varsikasikra watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Felix Varsikasikra helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The stretcher Felix Varsikasikra lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Felix Varsikasikra is back at S-F12, and someone else is lying in that dent now. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Ivo "Smokes" Fox, grazed. Felix Varsikasikra cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Northwick. Every version sounded like the ration bell. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Varsikasikra fired once through the steel loophole at S-F12 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Nils Lafayette was gravely wounded. Felix Varsikasikra was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F12. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Benedikt Pablo of the Concord (@pablo404585). The bearers reached Felix Varsikasikra at S-F12 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Benedikt Pablo of the Concord (@pablo404585).

Teodor Varsikasikra put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Felix Varsikasikra helped clear the shelf without saying why. Teodor Varsikasikra reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Teodor Varsikasikra crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Edmund "Smokes" Jakubwilkuu reached for a rifle. Teodor Varsikasikra was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@jakubwilkuu) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Teodor Varsikasikra landed next to Gideon Pearson in the Concord trench. Only Teodor Varsikasikra climbed back out. (@_william.pearson_) The letter for Teodor Varsikasikra was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Teodor Varsikasikra liked the crossed-out parts best.

Teodor Varsikasikra reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F12 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Quentin "Doc" Pbscn of the Concord (@pbscn_). The runner said a letter for Teodor Varsikasikra had come up with the ammunition. Teodor Varsikasikra went to get it before the ammunition.
walt_tmn: By the time Roland Tmn reached U-F13, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Roland Tmn followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Grey Mill. Roland Tmn let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Roland Tmn saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Tmn lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Tmn crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at U-F13 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Tmn drew a map of Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem's hometown from Button's stories. Button says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Tmn. Roland Tmn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Roland Tmn was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Roland Tmn was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Roland Tmn, and the soup went cold while Roland Tmn read it.
Roland Tmn did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
A letter came with Bastian Tmn: "I am Roland Tmn's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
wesley.gregory.00: Nobody asked Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory why he came. Nobody in V-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Wendel Jaranda, was gravely wounded. A round went through Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Emil Brianz of the Concord (@brianz149).
Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at V-F16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Pavel Velcic stood up to sing louder, and Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory fired. Pavel Velcic was gravely wounded. The singing stopped.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory waited for that to change. When it did, Dietrich Infante was gravely wounded.
whispertooth: Anselm Whispertooth reported to R-R1 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Anselm Whispertooth had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Gustav "Brick" Floooring was badly wounded. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Anselm Whispertooth read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Anselm Whispertooth's ear at R-R1 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Marek Seths of the Hegemony (@seths110). Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Anselm Whispertooth wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Back on the fire step at R-R1. Anselm Whispertooth says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Widow. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Widow hit all three. Anselm Whispertooth watched where the shots came from.
Anselm Whispertooth offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Anselm Whispertooth watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-R1 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Rafael Szy was badly wounded.
Anselm Whispertooth lay in the ruins of the Bone Quarry all day. the Widow did not fire once. Neither did Anselm Whispertooth. Both of them know.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Anselm Whispertooth waited for that to change. When it did, Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar was badly wounded.
